ns2:course.label: Digital Content and Social Media Management
ns2:course.description: Application of analytical planning concepts to advertising planning, decision making, and managing social media accounts. Covers all of the decision making areas of advertising and social media management. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ADV 281. Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
